verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents daily monitoring of compliance status with alerts for failing tests, and a view of failing tests and overdue tasks. It also markets per-framework 'audit ready' workflows, and its MCP server exposes controls, tests and frameworks. That implies a status view of passing and failing controls, but nothing describes a per-framework readiness percentage or a gap-to-audit summary. Missing for 10: an explicit per-framework readiness percentage, a documented passing-vs-open-gap breakdown per framework, any description of how readiness is calculated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
